title: Smooth pullback of a test form by a compactly supported perturbation of the identity is a test form
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^P, K' ⊆ E compact, ψ : E → E a C^∞ map with ψ(x) = x for every x ∉ K', and α a test d-form on E (C^∞ with compact support; IsTestForm α). Define the pullback ψ^#α by (ψ^#α)(x) := α(ψ(x))∘Dψ(x), i.e. (α (ψ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ ψ x). Then ψ^#α is a test form (IsTestForm (ψ^#α)) and tsupport(ψ^#α) ⊆ tsupport α ∪ K'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (K' : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (α : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d), IsCompact K' → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → (∀ x, x ∉ K' → ψ x = x) → IsTestForm α → IsTestForm (fun x => (α (ψ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) ∧ tsupport (fun x => (α (ψ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) ⊆ tsupport α ∪ K'
